title: Splats Crosshair
description: Changes your Crosshair to the one you see on the icon!
body: This is a crosshair made for PvP! (Works with crosshair mods)This is a texturepack that changes you crosshair,the crosshair is ment for pvp but can also be used for simgleplayer and smp´s! hope you enjoy are Crosshair please let us know of any glitches that remove the crosshair of your screen!
